_comment: Real-robot settings for run_policy.py / teach_plate.py. Units: metres, rad unless the key says otherwise. Edit after measuring; every TODO must be filled before mode 'real'.
_table_z_m: tabletop height in the arm frame (table CAD: arm base on 40 mm rails). teach_plate 'table' checks the TCP against it.
_gripper_effort: 0.001 N*m; 3000 ~ 30 N assumed (spec 50 N at max). Pen test: 2000 held, 1000 slipped once.
_gripper_real_to_sim: [real reading, sim opening] pairs, measured 2026-11-13 at effort 3000 (results/20261113_gripcal): closed empty 0.30 mm -> 0; closed on a 2x2 brick 36.00 mm -> 31.8 (sim brick width); commanded 50000 um read 50.20 mm -> 50. Effort 3000 read back -2.087 N*m, the same as effort 2000 (-2.086), so the grip force may be capped near 2 N*m.
_effort_abort_nm: TODO tune: abort if |joint effort| exceeds this (0.001 N*m feedback / 1000). Set to the air-run maximum plus margin; the press will raise J2/J3.
_timing_budget_ms: read -> send must stay under this (sim assumed ~10-15 ms command delay inside the firmware); period must stay 40 +- 2 ms
